title: Assessing WHAM/Model VII against field measurements of free metal ion concentrations: model performance and the role of uncertainty in parameters and inputs
why_relevant: Main paper read in full (open here). It compiles field free-ion data (Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, Cd, Pb; 2-35 samples per dataset, Table 2) and WHAM/Model VII predictions, but the main text gives no per-sample pH: Tables 4-6 give only dataset means of observed and predicted log free ion, and Figs 6-11 plot observed vs predicted (no pH axis). Theoretical pH 5.0-8.5 runs were made but only pH 7 is shown (Fig. 3). No free-ion vs pH slope can be extracted from the main paper.
data_expected: Accessory publication Tables A1 and A2: sources of pH, DOC and major solutes for each field sample (may allow per-sample pH to be paired with observed free ions read from Figs 6-11 or the original papers).

authors: Unsworth ER, Warnken KW, Zhang H, Davison W, et al.
title: Model predictions of metal speciation in freshwaters compared to measurements by in situ techniques
why_relevant: Cited by Rey-Castro et al. 2009 (ref 11) and as dataset source in Lofts & Tipping 2011 (Cu-06, Pb-02, Cd-03: PLM and DMT). Several speciation codes (NICA-Donnan, WHAM) against DGT, DMT, PLM, voltammetry in the same waters.
data_expected: Per-site pH, DOC and measured/modelled free and labile Cu, Pb, Cd, Zn, Ni in a few Swiss/European fresh waters.

authors: Kalis EJJ, Weng LP, Dousma F, Temminghoff EJM, van Riemsdijk WH
title: Measuring free metal ion concentrations in situ in natural waters using the Donnan Membrane Technique
why_relevant: Cited in Rey-Castro et al. 2009 (ref 34) and Lofts & Tipping 2011 (ref [6], datasets Ni-03, Cu-07, Zn-04, Cd-04, Pb-03). DMT free ions with NICA-Donnan predictions in Dutch surface waters.
data_expected: Per-site pH, DOC, free (DMT) and total Cu, Zn, Cd, Ni, Pb, with NICA-Donnan predictions.
